dogecoin.text:

Meanwhile, Vitalik's AI-Web3 dreams get memed to oblivion.  
Solana's DeFi cashflow screams HODL, but TRUMP coin? Pure clown show.

Dogecoin to the moon or just Elon's next pump?  
Solana memecoins popping off, but it's a rugpull casino.  
Vitalik's AI-Web3 dreams sound cool, but show me the code.  
Crypto bros, stop shilling TRUMP coins - my wallet's already crying.
